utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Appreciate that, Ira. I’ll stick to the plan and check back in later.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — if I hear anything about the repair drive, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m in — just give me the time and drop-off spot for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — Saturday 10am at the community center lot. Just pull in by the side entrance and we’ll take it from there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, I’ll be there Saturday at 10 by the side entrance.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is still happening, right? I just want to make sure I’ve got the details straight.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, it’s still happening, but I’m a bit worried about the logistics. I want to make sure we’ve got the timing and drop-off details sorted before we say anything else.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — so it’s still on, just not fully locked in yet, right?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive! I’m happy to help, though I may need a quick reminder on what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We still need tools, screws, and a few spare boards for the repair drive. If you can bring any of that, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I can do that—I'll look for some tools, screws, and spare boards and bring what I find.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the repair drive details before I act?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m a bit fuzzy on the details, but I can help check what’s been posted and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah. Please check the posted details and let me know the time, location, and what items they’re accepting.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Jules, sorry I’m late—what still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries—mostly we just need a few hands for sorting donations and loading the van. If you’re up for it, I can point you to the busiest spot.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, point me to the busiest spot—I can start there and help with loading.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive, Gus—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam — could you help sort donations and hand out tools when folks arrive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Gus — I’ll sort the donations and hand out tools when people arrive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll keep an eye on where the repair drive is happening and let you know once I confirm the location.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Opal — I appreciate it. Just let me know once you’ve confirmed the location.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m checking now and I’ll let you know as soon as I confirm the location.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive’s getting a good turnout, which is great news for the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It really is! I’ve already been telling folks to come by, and I’m happy to spread the word to anyone else who might want to help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s so kind of you, Quinn — every extra hand makes a difference. I’ll keep passing it along too!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Rey, what’s still left to fix for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still checking a few homes, but I know the old fence by the alley and one leaky roof still need attention.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I can help with the fence or the roof. Which one should we tackle first?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m in for the repair drive — I’ll bring it up with a couple neighbors and help repeat the plan.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, thanks, Vik — that really helps. I’ll keep an ear out and pass along whatever I hear.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep spreading the word and make sure the plan stays clear.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll help keep the repair drive organized and moving. What’s the first thing you want to tackle?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Rosa. Let’s start with sorting the donated tools and setting aside the broken ones for fixing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — I’ll set up two tables: one for the working tools and one for the broken ones. Once we sort them, we can label everything and make a quick fix list.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, hey Eli — I heard the repair drive is getting organized, and folks are already starting to drop off tools and supplies. If you need the details, I can pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’d be helpful, Tess. Please pass along the time and where to drop things off, and I’ll stick to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — it starts Saturday at 10 a.m. by the community shed, and you can drop off tools and supplies there.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what do you need help with for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — I’m organizing the repair drive and could use help sorting donations and setting up the tables.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can help with sorting donations and setting up the tables. Just point me where to start.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard the latest, but I’m glad people are helping out. If you want, I can ask around and see what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’s kind of you, Rey. I’d appreciate you asking around.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course — I’ll check with a few neighbors and let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — what do you need me to help with for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Could you help me check which homes are on the repair list and where they’re located? I want to make sure I’ve got every address right.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I can help with that—send me the list and I’ll check the addresses and locations.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can help spread the word about the repair drive and connect folks who might want to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — before we spread the word, can you confirm the date, time, and where people should show up?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I don’t have the date, time, or location yet, so I should confirm those first before I share anything. Once I’ve got them, I’ll pass them along right away.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I might’ve missed the latest details; what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Just help spread the word and bring any tools you can spare—I'll send the latest details your way.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll spread the word and see what tools I can lend. Send me the details when you can.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive’s getting some good traction. I can swing by and drop off a few supplies if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’d be a big help, Ira. I’m at the shed all afternoon—just bring whatever you’ve got, and we’ll put it to use.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good—I’ll stop by the shed later with what I can gather.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Leo — I can help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam — could you help collect tools and basic supplies for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll gather the tools and basic supplies for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d like to know the timing and what needs to be brought so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It’s this Saturday morning, and we mainly need gloves, a screwdriver, and any spare paint brushes you’ve got. Can you make it?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can make Saturday morning, but I’d like the exact start time and where we should meet so I can get there on time.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, great timing — I’m gathering folks for the repair drive, and you should come by. I’ll send the details your way right now.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure thing — send me the details and I’ll come by to help keep track of supplies.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll send over the time and meeting spot in a minute. Thanks for helping keep track of supplies!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school drop-off and pickup—what time is the repair drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Faye — I’m a bit fuzzy on the exact time right now, but I’ll check and get back to you soon.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: No problem—just let me know when you have it, and I’ll work around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll keep the repair drive organized and make sure everyone knows where to bring their items.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll spread the word as best I can and send folks your way if they ask.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Nell — that helps a lot. If anyone has questions, send them my way and I’ll keep everything moving smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping an eye on the repair drive location—do you want me to check where it’s set up or how to get there?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, could you check where it’s set up and the easiest way to get there? I’d appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll check where it’s set up and the easiest route, then I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, right — I’ve mostly been hearing bits and pieces, so I’m not fully caught up yet. What’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It’s shaping up well — folks are pooling tools and a few fixes are already lined up. If you want, I can send you the details and the time.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great, thanks — I’m still catching up on the details. Send me the time too, and I’ll do my best to be there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on the supplies for the repair drive—what do you still need?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Cleo. I still need a few hand tools and some spare screws if you’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check the shed for hand tools and spare screws and set them aside for you.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I haven’t gathered my things yet, but I can help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Oren — before you head over, can you check what tools or supplies you already have? That’ll help us avoid bringing duplicates.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure, I’ll check what I already have and let you know. I might need a minute because I’ve misplaced things before, but I’ll do my best.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time is the repair drive, and do you need me to bring anything?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I’m still sorting the time out, but I’ll let you know as soon as I have it. And if you could bring a couple of gloves, that’d be really helpful.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Of course — I’ll bring a couple of gloves and keep my schedule flexible. Just send me the time when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Uli — I can lend a hand with tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Gus. I’ll let you know what I need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Anytime, Uli — happy to help out when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, thanks for the update — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Ira. If you hear anything about the repair drive, could you let me know?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — I’ll let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — I like having a clear plan. Tell me what you need done for the repair drive, and I’ll keep to the routine.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great — I’ll lay out the repair drive plan and keep it simple: gather the broken items, sort what can be fixed, and check in before anything gets tossed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me. I’ll stick to the plan and check in before anything gets tossed.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Could you bring your gloves and a screwdriver? If you’ve got a free hour, we could also use an extra pair of hands sorting the donations.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll bring my gloves and a screwdriver, and I can give you that extra hour to sort donations too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what do you need help with for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No worries — could you help sort the donated tools and load the boxes into my truck?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure — I can sort the donated tools and help load the boxes into your truck.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Mostly hands and a pickup truck, honestly. If you can swing by Saturday, I’ll point you at the biggest jobs.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can do Saturday. I’ll bring my pickup and come ready to tackle the biggest jobs.
